newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open unchanged.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open unchanged.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open little changed on Wednesday, trading sources said.

In fundamental news, Taiwan said it passed on a 30,000-tonne raw sugar shipment due to high bid prices at at tender in New York City. A Taiwan Sugar official declined to disclose prices for the tender.
Russian sugar beet sowing had reached 148,000 hectares by April 21, down one percent from the same year-ago period.
Meantime, about 140,000 tonnes of imported raw sugar remained at Russia's Black Sea port of Novorossiisk due to bad weather and a lack of rail wagons to carry the sugar inland, a port official said.

Tuesday, most-active CSCE July sugar ended up 0.04 cent per lb to 11.12 cents per lb, having ranged from 11.13 to 11.04 cents. May rose 0.03 on the day to 11.27 cents, while the outer months closed unchanged to 0.02 higher.
Resistance remained at 11.18 cents in July and support at 11.00 cents.
The last trading day for the May contract is April 30.
LIFFE white sugar futures were tightly mixed on Wednesday. At 0845 EST/1345 GMT, August stood $0.20 higher at $311.10, while the back months were unchanged to down $0.20.
((-- S Rostler New York Commodity Desk, 212-859-1640))
